title: Cervical Cancer Prevention
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to cervical cancer prevention.
evidence_strength: Strong evidence supports HPV vaccination and screening as effective means to prevent cervical cancer. Observational and randomized controlled trials robustly demonstrate vaccine safety and efficacy. Screening guidelines derive from population studies confirming early detection reduces mortality. Some limitations remain in reaching underserved populations and overcoming behavioral barriers, which are areas of moderate evidence and ongoing research.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
